units: <cite ref="Taanit 27b:11">Taan. 27ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 22a:10">Meg. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>פּוֹסֵק</he> the reader divides (one verse), i.e. the first reads two verses and a half, leaving the other half to be read by his successor.
<cite ref="Megillah 22a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>לא התיר לי לִפְסוֹק וכ׳</he> he permitted me to cut a verse in two only in teaching the school children.

<cite ref="Megillah 31b:8">Ib. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>במשנה תורה פוסק</he> the chapter in Deuteronomy containing the curses (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 28:15-69">Deut. XXVIII, 15—69</cite>) may be divided (to be read by two or more); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:2">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> <he>כיון שפסקה</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 16">Yalk. ib. 16</cite> <he>שפוסקה</he>, v. <cite ref="Q02195"><he>פָּתַק</he></cite>.]—Part. pass. <cite ref="Q01249"><he>פָּסוּק</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="Q01251"><he>פְּסוּקָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:3">Ḥull. III, 3</cite> <he>פְּסוּקַת הגרגרת</he>, v. <cite ref="C01265"><he>גַּרְגֶּרֶת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chagigah 15a">Ḥag. 15ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>פְּסוֹק לי פְּסוּקְךָ</he> (interch. with Chald. <he>פסוק לי פסוקיך</he>) recite to me thy Bible verse (recently learned).

senses.gloss: (cmp. חָתַךְ, גָּזַר) to apportion, assign; to provide; to promise, agree.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 65a:1">Keth. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>אין פּוֹסְקִין יינות לאשה</he> in decreeing alimentation for a woman we do not provide for wine.
<cite ref="Ketubot 65a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>כך תִּפְסְקוּ לבנותיכם</he> so much (and no more) may ye grant to your daughters.
<cite ref="Ketubot 107a:1">Ib. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>פוסקין מזונות לאשת איש</he> the court assigns alimentation (from the estate) to a deserted wife.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:8">Ib. V, 8</cite> <he>לא פ׳ … אלא וכ׳</he> only R. Y. decreed barley as a part of alimentation, because he lived near Edom.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:8">Ib.</cite> <he>פוסק לעומתן וכ׳</he> he must give her &c., v. <cite ref="P00281"><he>עוּמָּה</he></cite>. Ib. VI, 2 <he>הפוסק מעות לחתנו</he> if a man agrees to pay a certain amount to his intended son-in-law (on the date of marriage). Ib. 3 <he>פָּסְקָה להכניס … הוא פוסק וכ׳</he> if she promises to bring to him one thousand Denars, he must assign to her (as settlement in the K’thubah) fifteen Manehs. Tosef. ib. XIII (XII), 1 <he>אם פָּסְקוּ לה … מה שפסקו פסקו</he> if the court has granted her (alimentation), what they have granted, is granted. Ib. <he>פסקה היא לעצמה</he> (not <he>על עצמה</he>) if she herself has promised (to bring her husband a certain sum, and now her father refuses to give it). Ib. <he>אבה פ׳ עלי וכ׳</he> my father has promised for me; what can I do (if he retracts)?; <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:5">Keth. XIII, 5</cite>. Y. Kidd. IV, 65ᶜ top <he>פּוֹסְקֵי צדקה ברבים וכ׳</he> those who subscribe to a charity in public and refuse to pay; <cite ref="Taanit 8b">Taan. 8ᵇ</cite>; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to fix a price; to buy on time.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 58a:10">Gitt. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>אפדנו בכל ממון שפוסקין עליו</he> I will redeem him for any price that they may set on him.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:7">B. Mets. V, 7</cite> <he>אין פוסקין … עד שיצא השער</he> you dare not fix a price on crops (buy on time), until the market price has been published.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:7">Ib.</cite> <he>יצא השער פוסקין ואע״פ שאין לזה יש לזה</he> (missing in Y. ed.) when the market price is out, you may buy, for although he (the seller) has no goods as yet, others have.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:7">Ib.</cite> <he>פוסק עמו על הגדיש</he>, v. <cite ref="C00219"><he>גָּדִישׁ</he></cite>; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 44b:6">Snh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>פיסקון שפוסק דברים כלפי מעלה</he> Gabriel is surnamed Pisḳon, because he argues with the Lord.

senses.gloss: (neut. verb) to be cut off; to cease, be stopped.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:9">Sot. IX, 9</cite> <he>משרבו … פסקו המים המרים … הפסיקן</he> when the faithless men became frequent, the application of the waters of jealousy ceased, and it was R. J. ben Z. that abolished them.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:12">Ib. 12</cite> <he>פסקו אנשי אמונה</he> the men of faith ceased to exist. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 16 <he>אין אותה מצוה פוֹסֶקֶת מביתו</he> that good deed shall never cease from (being practiced in) his house.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:1">Gen. R. s. 52</cite> <he>פסקו העוברים והשבים</he> travellers ceased to pass by; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to be split, cut in two, broken.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 11:15">Tosef. B. Kam. XI, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>הנ׳ במגירה</he> chips at planing, v. <cite ref="C01392"><he>גָּרַר</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> <he>נשברה השדרה ונ׳ החוט שלה</he> if the spinal column is broken and the spinal cord severed.

<cite ref="Shabbat 112a:9">Sabb. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>סנדל שנִפְסְקוּ שתי אזניו</he> a sandal, both ears (loops) of which are torn off; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 5</cite> <he>שנִתְפַּסְּקוּ</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:4">Kel. XXVI, 4</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 3:5">Tosef. Mikv. III, 5</cite>, sq. <he>ונפסקו</he>, v. <cite ref="Q02195"><he>פָּתַק</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to separate, sever connection; to form a partition.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 38b">Sot. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ מחיצה … אינה מַפְסֶקֶת בין וכ׳</he> not even an iron wall forms a partition between Israel and his father in heaven (worshippers form a congregation even if separated by a partition); <cite ref="Pesachim 85b">Pes. 85ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 1:2">Peah. I, 2</cite> <he>ואלו מַפְסִיקִין לפאה</he> the following things form a division of fields with regard to Peah: a brook &c.
Ab. Zar. 52ᵃ את ה׳ הענין the word eth (before ĕlohehem Deut. XII, 2) divides the subject (so as not to allow an analogy between idolatrous utensils and the idols themselves), v. next w.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to interrupt; to cause to cease; to leave off; to pause.
units: Ber. II, 2 בין ויאמר לאמת ויציב לא יַפְסִיק between the last portion of the Sh’mʿa (Num. XV, 37-41) and ‘Ĕmeth V’yatsib’ one must not pause (interrupt the prayer to greet a person &c.). Ib. 14ᵃ במגילה מהו שיפסיק may one interrupt one’s self during the reading of the M’gillah? [Ib. also פּוֹסֵק Kal.] Ib. V, 1.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2:6">Ex. R. s. 2</cite> <he>עם כל הנביאים ה׳ מלדבר … לא ה׳ מימיו</he> with all other prophets the Lord ceased from speaking at times, but with Moses he never ceased.

<cite ref="Taanit 30a:4">Taan. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>סעודה המַפְסִיק בה</he> the meal with which one ceases (the last meal before beginning to fast, called <he>סעודה המַפְסֶקֶת</he>). Y. Nidd. I, 49ᶜ <he>והִפְסִיקָה שלש עונות</he> and ceased (to have menstruation) for three periods.

<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 3:6">Meg. III, 6</cite> <he>אין מַפְסִיקִין בקללות וכ׳</he> in reading the curses (<cite ref="Leviticus 26:14-44">Lev. XXVI, 14-44</cite>; <cite ref="Deuteronomy 28:15-69">Deut. XXVIII, 15-69</cite>) you must not break off, but one person must read the whole &c. Ib. 31ᵇ <he>מקום שמפסיקין בשבת וכ׳</he> where they leave off reading on Sabbath morning, there they continue in the afternoon &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:9">Sot. IX, 9</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52">Gen. R. s. 52</cite>, beg. <he>מה אני מפסיק צדקה מביתי</he> shall I allow charity to cease in my house (to fall into desuetude from want of opportunity)?; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cut sprays off, trim, v. פָּסַג.

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Parah 5:9">Tosef. Par. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 4:9">IV</cite>), 9 <he>מפסיק ומנגב</he> he makes a dam (cuts off the influx) and lays the cavity dry.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 11:18">Tosef. B. Kam. XI, 18</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01227"><he>פָּסַג</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to interrupt.—Part. pass. מְפוּסָּק; pl. מְפוּסָּקִין. Y. Pes. X, 37ᶜ; Y. Sabb. VIII, beg. 11ᵃ מהו לשתותן מפ׳ how about drinking them (the four cups of the Passover evening) in pauses (sipping)?, v. פִּיסָּק.
to cut down, ruin; to cut to pieces. Pesik. Naḥ., p. 128ᵃ קיצצוהו ופִיסְּקוּהוּ they cut it down and ruined it (the vineyard).
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4">Lam. R. to IV, 15</cite> <he>והיתה … עליהן ומְפַסַּקְתָּן</he> the carriage passed over them and dismembered them; Pesik. Vattom., p. 133ᵇ <he>ומפסקתה</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 266">Yalk. Is. 266</cite> <he>והיתה … עליה ומְפַסַּקְתָּהּ</he>; a. e.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 5</cite>, v. supra.

senses.gloss: (sub. בעינים, cmp. קרץ, Prov. X, 10; VI, 13) to blink.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 5">Deut. R. s. 5</cite> <he>עשה עצמו מִתְפַּסֵּק</he> he pretended to be blinking (Y. Sot. I, 16ᵈ bot., a. e. <he>עבד גרמיה חשש בעייניה</he>).
